text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you describe the appearance and distribution of your rash in more detail? Additionally, have you noticed any specific triggers or changes in your symptoms over time?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Porphyria Cutanea Tarda (PCT) with peripheral neuropathy.

The combination of a chronic pruritic rash on sun-exposed areas (face/upper body) and sensory neuropathy in a patient with livestock exposure strongly suggests an acquired porphyria, likely triggered by alcohol, estrogens, or iron overload often associated with farming stress or hemochromatosis. Have you noticed any blisters or scarring on the rash, and do you have a history of liver disease or excessive alcohol consumption?
